g.title: ALGS_QSP
g.text: Alagille Syndrome (ALGS) — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Map
JAG1/NOTCH2 haploinsufficiency → bile duct paucity → cholestasis → pruritus, xanthoma, growth failure, biliary cirrhosis
= R/(S+R), the fraction of the hepatocyte bile-acid load that arrived by enterohepatic return —
the hard ceiling on every IBAT inhibitor, itself a function of ductal capacity J
Calibrated to ICONIC (maralixibat, n=31), ASSERT (odevixibat, n=52), GALA natural history (n=1433), MRX-vs-GALA event-free survival (n=84 vs 469)
